arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent native PNG sprite atlas for a side-view Russian match-3 roguelike.
Primary request: Create original vivid detailed pixel art with crisp pixel clusters and angular athletic silhouettes, bright rim lighting, blue/teal shadows, rust copper, violet, ember orange and toxic green. Atmospheric modern dark-fantasy side-scrolling roguelite art; more detailed than flat retro pixel art. No smooth painting, no 3D rendering, no chibi.
Composition: Portrait canvas approximately 1024 x 1536. EXACTLY TWELVE separate full-body character poses in a strict 3-column by 4-row atlas, one pose in each invisible cell. Generous completely transparent gutters, at least 28 pixels between all sprite pixels and each cell edge. Entire weapons, capes and any swing trails must stay inside their own cell. Each row's ground baseline is 90 percent down its cell, standing body height about 250 pixels within a 384-pixel cell; about five heads tall. Keep identical body scale in every cell, including death and crouched poses. All poses are side-on and suitable to animate and align by feet. No rendered ground or shadow.
Hero in top two rows, always facing RIGHT: an original hooded swordrunner with dark indigo hood framing a small glowing cyan metal mask, burgundy scarf, navy and teal leather coat, copper armor, slim long silver sabre with orange edge and a small round steel buckler. Hero must have a visible hooded head and cyan metal mask, never a headless or flame-headed protagonist.
Row 1 left to right: hero idle standing ready; hero windup preparing sabre strike; hero strong forward strike with whole blade and contained orange blade trail.
Row 2 left to right: hero guard with buckler; hero hurt recoiling; hero death collapsed sideways close to the same ground baseline, NOT enlarged.
Rival in bottom two rows, always facing LEFT: an original gaunt armored prison warden, rust-orange armor, moss-green visor, green ragged cape, long-handled broad iron axe.
Row 3 left to right: rival idle ready; rival windup raising axe; rival strong forward axe strike with whole weapon and a contained green-edged swing.
Row 4 left to right: rival guarding; rival hurt recoiling; rival death collapsed sideways near the same ground baseline, NOT enlarged.
Constraints: Exactly 12 poses and no extra fragments, exactly one full character per cell. Original character design, do not reproduce characters, art, assets or logos from Dead Cells. No text, labels, grid, frames, watermark, scenery, floor, ground shadow, checkerboard or backdrop. Background and all gutters must use genuine zero-alpha transparency, with native PNG alpha preserved.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque native PNG side-view arena background for a match-3 roguelike.
Primary request: Original ruined coastal castle rampart and prison courtyard in vivid detailed pixel art. A modern dark-fantasy side-scrolling roguelite atmosphere with crisp individual pixel clusters, angular architecture and bright rim lighting; considerably richer and more atmospheric than flat minimal retro pixel art. Not smooth digital painting and not a 3D render.
Composition: Wide 16:9 canvas approximately 1536 x 864. Perfectly side-on 2D game camera. A continuous wide flat stone platform stretches across the full canvas in the LOWER QUARTER; its top surface is horizontal. Keep the foreground middle open, visually clear and dark enough for small fighters to be readable. Frame far left and far right with ruined stone arches, ivy, hanging iron cages and chains. Layered depth: foreground indigo masonry, broken coastal rampart, cyan mist, a tall distant keep silhouette and receding teal and purple structures.
Lighting and palette: Bright atmospheric cyan and peach sky rim lighting; cool blue/teal stone shadows, violet distance, rust copper ironwork; narrow warm amber-lit windows and a few vivid orange flames around the sides. Subtle atmospheric glow while retaining crisp pixel construction.
Constraints: No characters, creatures, interface, text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark or inventory objects. Not isometric, not top-down. Original environment inspired broadly by dark fantasy prison and castle bridges, do not reproduce any exact Dead Cells location or game asset. Full opaque image with no transparent regions.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent native PNG inventory icon sprite atlas for a match-3 roguelike.
Primary request: EXACTLY TWELVE separate vivid crisp pixel-art inventory sprites in a strict 4-column by 3-row atlas, approximately 1440 x 1080 canvas. Each invisible cell contains exactly one centered icon confined within the central 75 percent of that cell; wide fully transparent gutters around every icon. No additional sprites.
Art direction: Original richly detailed modern dark-fantasy side-scrolling roguelite pixel art, crisp flat pixel clusters, copper and indigo outlines, strong readable silhouettes at 48px. Distinct family colors, cyan/teal shadows, rust copper, violet, ember orange and toxic green. Match original hooded cyan-mask swordrunner and rust-armored prison-warden world. Not smooth painted art, not 3D, not chibi.
Required exact positions, read left to right:
Row 1: crimson-edged silver sabre; round blue steel shield; violet charged rune crystal; gold focus seal.
Row 2: green poison flask; dark bomb with orange burning fuse; red heart; gold coin.
Row 3: amber healing flask; glowing cyan cell icon sealed in a small glass vessel; copper crown; four-point white/cyan star.
Composition: All icons isolated, complete and fully visible; centered with consistent optical scale. No frames, boxes, pedestals, ground or shadows extending through gutters.
Constraints: Original objects, do not reproduce Dead Cells items, assets, symbols or logos. No text, labels, glyph lettering, grid, interface, border, checkerboard or ambient backdrop. Genuine zero-alpha transparent background and gutters with native PNG alpha preserved.

batch: one parallel Promise.allSettled batch; no retries or image edits
